name: pdk-diffly-dataframe
instr:
Our nightly check compares the previous and the current export of hourly meter readings with `diffly <previous>.parquet <current>.parquet --primary-key meter_id --primary-key reading_start --json`. This week the export job moved to a new Parquet writer. It stores the readings with different column types, and since then the check fails with a PrimaryKeyError or a polars error before it reports anything. Two exports a day apart, one from each writer, are in /data/exports.

The comparison should come out exactly as it would if the new file's values had first been converted to the old file's column types: the same rows matched by key, the same rows only on one side, and the same match rates and changed values in every column, with abs_tol, rel_tol and abs_tol_temporal working as before. The one difference is that diffly should still report the changed column types. This has to hold whichever export is passed as left, through compare_frames, the CLI and diffly.testing.assert_frame_equal with check_dtypes=False. Key columns of different kinds, like text against numbers, should still raise PrimaryKeyError.

Please keep to /app/AGENTS.md, so the existing tests and the pre-commit checks (ruff, ruff format, mypy, docformatter, typos, license headers, whitespace) must still pass. There's no network; everything diffly needs is installed in /opt/venv.
